data.one_liner: Platform-specific way to exit a Flutter app cleanly without calling exit(0).
data.what_it_does: Provides a plugin method to exit the application properly on Android and iOS. On Android, it finishes the activity and removes it from the task list. On iOS, it gracefully suspends the app or optionally force-kills it.
use_when: You need to provide a clean app exit mechanism from within the UI
You want to avoid using Dart's exit(0) for a more graceful shutdown
avoid_when: You want to rely on the standard operating system behavior where users manage app closure
You are targeting iOS App Store compliance and plan to use force-exit mode without an enterprise or specific requirement
strengths: Apple guideline compliant default behavior for iOS
Cleanly removes the app from the Android recent tasks list
Written in modern Kotlin and Swift with full null-safety
weaknesses: Force-exit mode on iOS may cause the app to appear to crash and can lead to App Store review rejection
Programmatically exiting apps is generally discouraged by mobile platforms
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum iOS 13.0 and Android API 21.
